d: Britain’s net migration has plunged to its lowest level since 1997, marking a major victory for the government’s tougher immigration policies. But there is a striking twist: Indians are leading the exodus, with 85,000 leaving the UK in the year ending June 2026. While thousands of Indians continue to arrive for education and employment, immigration from India has fallen sharply. Higher visa thresholds, rising living costs and uncertainty over permanent residency are making Britain less attractive.
